label: Uneasy calm
summary: The Iran war eased slightly. President Trump ruled out strikes for the day, and Iran's security chief prepared to host defence officials from Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan. Elsewhere in the region the fighting went on. The Saudi-led coalition struck Houthi-held Sanaa after a missile attack on Riyadh's airport, and Israeli strikes killed eight people in Gaza. In the DR Congo, attackers killed a nurse responding to an Ebola case in the country's deadliest outbreak on record. Two storms cut power to more than 150,000 homes in northern Europe. Elections brought change. Lula came from behind to win Brazil's runoff, though Bolsonaro has not conceded, and Serbia's Vucic conceded defeat to a student-led movement. Gulf oil flows are back near pre-war levels, but Brent remains around $114. The weighted formula gave 42; no editorial adjustment.
